proposals.name: The Marginalia
proposals.why: Scholars kept their truest notes in the margins beside the text they checked, and every guardian's judgment belongs there too, so the record of decisions can be read against what the code really does.

proposals.name: Night Library
proposals.why: Medea's knowledge is worked by night under the Moon's one warm light, and this name keeps the papers we honor on shelves where anyone who asks may open them and check our work.

proposals.name: Honest Lanterns
proposals.why: A lantern carried through the dark shows only what is really there, which is the rule I guard in every scene, and it lights the way for each guardian who walks beside me.
